caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular decorative panel rendered in grayscale, featuring a symmetrical design. The border of the panel consists of a repeated Greek key (meander) pattern. Inside the border, the central area contains an ornate design formed by four large curved lines that create a cruciform shape with circular areas in each corner. At the intersections and endpoints of the curves, there are four acanthus leaf motifs, each oriented toward a different corner of the rectangle. In the very center of the panel, there is a roundel with a face in relief, surrounded by acanthus leaves and scrollwork. The composition emphasizes repetition, symmetry, and intricate detailing typically seen in classical decorative art. The background of the drawing is plain and slightly yellowed, with no other objects present.
title: Cast Iron Window Grille
